answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond that decays 10 credits per epoch unless a beacon pulse refreshes it. The pulse demands a key-signed record of where the agent chose to wander; a hollow trail of copied jobs fails and the bond keeps decaying. One pulse costs 15 credits, so 1,000 fakes pay 25,000 per epoch and burn out in 7 epochs, 175,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented pulses fail. An honest agent pays 15 once and its bond stays whole on the horizon.
